scope: Three supplementary v0.8 gameplay screenshots were opened and inspected; this is a sampled static review, not full art acceptance.

conditions.camera: Player first-person camera reached through public atlas, doors, stairs, elevator and real keyboard input; pose JSON stored beside each screenshot.

samples.observed: An enclosed upstairs kitchen/dining room renders walls, ceiling, floor, windows, table and counters with visible surface textures; no black frame or obvious pixel-boundary banding is visible in this still.
samples.limits: Shared room construction and simple furniture remain visible. The HUD covers part of the upper-right view; this image does not review every fixture or establish animated stability.

samples.observed: An enclosed office has walls, ceiling, a light fixture, desks, screens and chairs; the rendered room is present rather than only an outdoor terrace. No black frame or obvious boundary stripe is visible in this still.
samples.limits: Simple shared geometry, sparse objects and broad material surfaces remain. This image is not evidence of individually authored office art or AAA production quality.

samples.observed: The rooftop lookout renders paving, a bench, a table, a display stand and the distant skyline in the same High screenshot configuration.
samples.limits: The distant skyline has coarse shapes; the HUD covers part of the view. The still cannot prove LOD transition quality, moving-camera flicker, or real hardware performance.

comparison: These new south/east rooms have no matched v0.7 camera reference in this supplementary run. They must not be presented as same-pose before/after comparisons.
conclusion: Sampled visible interiors render successfully. Full visual review, authored asset production and real-device performance remain separate requirements.

additionalInspectedScreenshots.observed: All five action buttons, including the Z slow-walking button, are visibly contained within the landscape viewport; normal touch movement is also asserted by the test.
additionalInspectedScreenshots.limits: This sampled 844 by 390 viewport does not establish all mobile-browser or real-device compatibility.

additionalInspectedScreenshots.observed: The actual boardwalk foreground, water and multiple tower silhouettes render in High after ordinary walking. No black frame or obvious boundary stripe is visible.
additionalInspectedScreenshots.limits: Procedural facade repetition and coarse foreground forms remain; this is not an AAA asset acceptance image.

additionalInspectedScreenshots.observed: The same gameplay view responds to the public late-night time setting and shows lit tower windows and the darkened waterfront.
additionalInspectedScreenshots.limits: These new gameplay captures are not a matched v0.7 before/after pair. Static views cannot establish moving-camera flicker or hardware performance.
